Run a bundled example app

Source: R/examples.R
run_example.Rd

Run a bundled example app

Usage

run_example(name = NULL)

Arguments

name

Example name. Call run_example() without arguments to list the available examples.

Value

The example names (invisibly when an example was run).

Examples

run_example()
#>  [1] "accessibility-demo" "buffer-demo"        "counter"           
#>  [4] "custom-widget"      "data-explorer"      "data-workbench"    
#>  [7] "database-explorer"  "dataframe-browser"  "editor"            
#> [10] "export-report"      "file-tree"          "form"              
#> [13] "hello"              "keys"               "kitchen-sink"      
#> [16] "model-monitor"      "sql-workspace"      "system-monitor"    
#> [19] "task-runner"        "terminal-dashboard"
